messages.author: 007f218d796527ab
messages.subject: Bayesian inference with differential equation in R
parts:
Hi D-RUG folks.

I used to use wsdiff package in R to do parameter estimation. However, there is no such a package in Mac platform. Do someone knows some other packages?

Thanks 

Yuzhao

messages.author: 4b16035cff9b0f8a
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Bayesian inference with differential equation in R
parts:
R packages should all be cross-compatible.

However, wsdiff is not listed in the CRAN packages, the CRAN archive, or the orphaned package list. Googling it also turns up nothing except a *nix command and a python script. Are you sure that is the correct package name?

messages.author: f8f554f3c8aec296
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Bayesian inference with differential equation in R
parts:
Yes winBugs doesn't work on Mac. Unless you use wine. Easier route is to look into jags or openbugs which are quite similar. I think both have  R interfaces; the packages are rjags and ropenbugs if I'm not mistaken 

If you're interested in exploring newer projects, nimble (de valpine et al) is another inference software based on the bugs language but more customizable 
- Jaime
